title: D.C. Nelson, Oliver's supposed nephew, and the trombonists
summary: They discuss D.C. Nelson, who passed as Joe Oliver's nephew but was not, and the trombonists Wilbur Parrish and Eddie Ory.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: There was an Ornette, you know, son Nelson.
Well he passed as Joe Oliver's nephew. That's the same call then I'm thinking. Yeah, that little cornet player, little trumpet player, he was just learning then. I never knew him.
Well Lewis called him uncle too. Oh yes.
But Nelson was supposed to be his nephew.
And then the trombone players was Wilbur, D. Parris. Yes. D.Wilbur.
